row: Darjeeling Animal Shelter is a registered Indian Trust founded in the year, 1995 founded by Dr. Christine Townend. The Trust runs two projects - Kalimpong Animal Shelter (KAS) and Darjeeling Animal Shelter (DAS). Both these sister Shelters focus primarily on the Animal Birth Control Programme on street and community dogs, Anti-Rabies Vaccination camp, Village camps - Where community service is provided to animals, and general plus emergency treatment of animals.
